description: ShikiForm — Formly-level abstraction, React immutable style, JSX-first. usage/ is the API spec; packages/ is the engine.
name: shikiform

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @shikiform/core && npm run build -w @shikiform/react && npm run build -w @shikiform/antd
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p packages/react --noEmit && tsc -p packages/antd --noEmit && tsc -p apps/e2e --noEmit
